verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers provides building blocks (Queues, Workflows, Durable Objects/Agents, batch-style event subscriptions, D1/KV) that a developer could use to construct bulk-processing pipelines, and Workflows explicitly supports chaining/retrying many steps, but there is no first-party 'bulk operation' primitive, batch API, or documented pattern for an AI-native user to trigger operations across many items at once as a single native capability. missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch API or UI action, evidence of an AI agent invoking bulk operations across many resources in one call, and independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows at scale.
